attacks.claim: Dark mode: .day-card has hardcoded white background while text color switches to light #f2f2f7 via --text. Card text (title, etc.) is near-invisible on ~30% of users' devices. The .meta uses --muted (#a1a1a6) on white, also low contrast.
QA only covers light mode and a 390px iPhone and 1440px desktop. Dark mode (30% of users) and 360px Android widths (where images overflow) were never tested, yet QA is presented as a pass.
attacks.evidence: Visual QA vs Figma: Chrome 1440px (light), Safari iPhone 14 (light) — pass

attacks.claim: Tile images are 320px wide with no max-width rule. At 360px viewport, content width is ~296px (16px page + 16px card padding each side), so images overflow the card on small phones.
attacks.evidence: with no img rule in planner.css

attacks.claim: The most frequent planner action (9.4/week/user, 64% on mobile) goes from a one-tap button to a ~6-step flow through the recipe page and servings sheet. Core-task friction regression.
attacks.evidence: tap the tile → recipe page → "Ingredients" tab → choose servings in the servings sheet → "Add to list" → toast with "Undo"; The old tile-level "+ List" button is removed

attacks.claim: Removing the shortcut for the top-used action to satisfy a declutter goal contradicts the brief's own usage data; no evidence or experiment supports the tradeoff, and it ships to 100%.
attacks.evidence: Most frequent planner action: adding a planned recipe's ingredients to the shopping list (avg 9.4 times/week ...). The old tile-level "+ List" button is removed to declutter tiles.

attacks.claim: Fixed 72px bottom action bar with no bottom padding on .planner and no safe-area inset, so Sunday's card and content will be covered by the bar on mobile, and the iOS home indicator may overlap buttons.
attacks.evidence: .action-bar { position: fixed; ... height: 72px; } and .planner { ... padding: 16px; } with "Sunday is the last child of .planner"

attacks.claim: The tile is a plain <li> with no link/button, yet the flow says tapping the tile opens the recipe. Keyboard and screen-reader users have no way to open a recipe from the tile; QA only verified the Move-to menu.
attacks.evidence:
• ...

    Sheet-pan gnocchi

    ... tap the tile → recipe page

attacks.claim: Rollout is 100% at once with no canary and no thresholds on watch metrics. Mitigated by the flag rollback, so not blocking in itself.
attacks.evidence: Ship to 100% Tue 10:00 PT behind `planner_v7` ... Watch: planner page JS errors, shopping-list additions/WAU, planner bounce rate.

attacks.claim: "Generate shopping list" has no stated handling of repeat presses/duplicates and no undo, unlike the per-recipe flow.
attacks.evidence: "Generate shopping list" (adds all planned recipes for the week)

attacks.claim: Swap and overflow buttons have no min tap-target size; only .btn-primary sets 48px.
Touch drag-to-move may conflict with scrolling on mobile; touch behavior is unspecified and untested.
attacks.evidence: Drag a recipe tile between days to move it.

attacks.claim: Share plan access model (link scope, token, expiry, data exposed) is not described.
attacks.evidence: ABSENT: Share plan mechanism; <button class="btn-ghost">Share plan</button>

attacks.claim: Hardcoded #ffffff on .day-card bypasses the --surface token, inviting repeat theming bugs.
